lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 8 distinct high-contrast white vertical lines are visible on the lateral torso. Spacing is non-uniform, with larger gaps in the anterior-midsection and decreasing interval widths towards the posterior.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The vertical line furthest to the posterior is a significantly abbreviated segment, terminating at approximately 40% of the vertical torso mass. Mid-torso lines exhibit minor pixel thinning near the dorsal crest.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A low-density grouping of 4 distinct white spots is visible on the upper posterior flank and hind limb junction.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two white spots on the lower posterior haunch align along a diagonal 45-degree axis relative to the ventral line.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns display a lyrate trajectory, diverging laterally from the base at approximately 30 degrees before curving inward and upward at the distal ends.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated pixel distance between horn tips is approximately 1.8 times the pixel width of the distance between the horn bases.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: High-contrast ivory tipping occupies approximately 10-15% of the total vertical length of each horn.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white chevron marking between the orbital regions and a distinct color transition to ochre/orange on the distal limbs below the carpal/tarsal joints.
